payload.outcome: Fixed in PR #2887 (merged 2026-09-18), with one correction to the row: the controls measured at 40px are on the SERVICES result card (services-navigator-page.tsx), not the therapy card. The real therapy card (therapy-compass/therapy-card.tsx) was already compliant and is the reference pattern — it varies padding only and lets controlBase own the height. Eight sm:min-h-10 step-downs plus one sm:min-w-10 were removed from the services page, so the 48px floor now holds at every width instead of dropping to 40px from 640px up. min-h-11 was deliberately NOT used: docs/design-system/TOKENS.md records that 44px reintroduces a known ui-smoke flake, and tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts pins 48. A new tests/services-tap-floor.test.ts walks the page AST, scoped to interactive tags so a container's sm:min-h-0 reset is not mistaken for a shrunken button.
